title: Plan a cohort from evidence, not a complexity score
description: Choose a teaching profile and change the cohort, measured network rate, worker slots, and retention. The model exposes exact storage, transfer, and worker-slot arithmetic.

assumptions.note: Profile values are illustrative planning inputs. Replace raw GiB, derived ratio, and slot-hours with measurements from representative samples and the exact workflow revision.
